api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('cut-patchnce')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, ignore_index=None, reduction='mean', **params); params may contain temperature=0.07
description: Single-layer PatchNCE for paired generated-query and source-key feature maps. Each query is compared with its aligned positive and other locations in the same image as negatives after channel-wise L2 normalization; temperature-scaled positive-class cross-entropy follows CUT §3.2 Eqs. (2)–(3) and Appendix C.3.

examples.title: Train paired patch features with PatchNCE

name: PatchNCE Loss

parameters.additional parameters: temperature is the only accepted keyword in **params; unknown keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None; continuous patch features do not define ignored labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point generated-query feature map shaped [B,C,S] with nonempty batch, channel, and patch dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns [B*S] patch losses, mean averages them, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point source-key feature map shaped [B,C,S], matching prediction in shape, dtype, and device
parameters.temperature: finite positive real scalar used to scale similarities (default 0.07)
